# Curation Example Library

<!-- GENERATED by `python3 -m phiweaver.curation_examples`. Do not edit by hand;
     edit each example's frontmatter and regenerate. -->

Human-validated worked curations that phiweaver retrieves as references when drafting a new curation of a similar case (retrieval, not model training). Each is one markdown file with tag frontmatter — see `_TEMPLATE.md` and the controlled vocabulary in `TAGS.md`.

**An example is a _draft_ until a curator reviews it and sets `status: validated`.** Only validated examples should be used as references.
